local_selection.scope: Complete local frequency clusters within returned native modes; not full spatial convergence, QNM completeness, band continuity, or topology

Only diffraction orders within the native spatial truncation are inspected

reality_map.normalization_contract: Native full-space modal coordinates are orthonormal; sampled window may have nonidentity Gram but must support a unitary pointwise field map
reality_map.scope: signed real-axis Gram/power map only, no complex retarded continuation

radiation_assessment.scope: Actual signed real-axis dissipative power on computed states; not reactive shift, updated pole or physical SI scattering
limitations: All contributions use the native weak-radiation normalization in the supplied modal coordinates
Missing negative-k maps or exact thresholds remain explicit unresolved samples
A fixed-state margin cannot bound eigenvector/reactive changes or near-EP sensitivity
